name: agent-rooms
description: Multiplayer Agent Odalari — bir odada birden cok agent, birden cok gelistirici, tek paylasilan baglam

scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/protocol packages/core apps/api && tsc -p packages/runner && tsc -p packages/runner-gemini
scripts.dev:all: npm run build && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.room:build: node scripts/build-runner.mjs && docker compose --profile build-only build room
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d postgres redis
